entries.title: Ezekiel 35:1
segments: ¶Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:2
segments: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:3
segments: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I [am] against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate. {most...: Heb. desolation and desolation}

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:4
segments: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:5
segments: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed [the blood of] the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time [that their] iniquity [had] an end: {perpetual...: or, hatred of old} {shed...: Heb. poured out the children} {force: Heb. hands}

: {perpetual...: or, hatred of old} {shed...: Heb. poured out the children} {force: Heb. hands}

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:6
segments: Therefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:7
segments: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth. {most...: Heb. desolation and desolation}

words.text: from it him that passeth out

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:8
segments: And I will fill his mountains with his slain [men]: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:9
segments: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:10
segments: ¶Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there: {whereas...: or, though the LORD was there}

words.text: shall be mine, and we will possess
was there: {whereas...: or, though the LORD was there}

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:11
segments: Therefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.

among them, when I have judged

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:12
segments: And thou shalt know that I [am] the LORD, [and that] I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume. {to consume: Heb. to devour}

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:13
segments: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard [them]. {boasted: Heb. magnified}

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:14
segments: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:15
segments: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, [even] all of it: and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.
